name: Hada Labo

lead: Hada Labo is a skincare brand from Rohto Pharmaceutical, launched in Japan in 2004. Its best-known product is the Gokujyun hyaluronic acid lotion, a light, watery toner-style product intended to leave skin hydrated, which people use for a plumper, smoother-looking complexion [1][2].
The brand emphasizes simple formulas without added fragrance, colorant or mineral oil [1]. Hyaluronic acid is a humectant listed in cosmetic ingredient databases for skin conditioning [3].

paras: Users apply the lotion after cleansing, often in several thin layers, then follow with a moisturizer; the brand also sells serums, creams, masks and cleansers [2]. Visible hydration is typically noticed within days.
Fragrance-free, simple formulas are the brand's selling point [1]. As with any topical product, individual skin reactions can occur.

chain: Hyaluronic acid lotion applied in layers
angle.text: Humectant hydration temporarily plumps the outer skin layers, softening the look of dryness and fine lines. People use the lotion as a hydrating base under moisturizer and sunscreen.

lead: Hada Labo (Japanese for roughly 'skin laboratory') is a skincare brand developed by Rohto Pharmaceutical, launched in Japan in 2004 [1][2]. It is best known for its Gokujyun line, headed by a hyaluronic acid lotion, and its appeal for appearance is hydration: well-hydrated skin looks plumper and finer-lined, and the lotion is a common first step in Japanese-style layered routines [2].

The brand's stated approach was a 'simplistic' one, removing unnecessary additives, colorant, fragrance and mineral oil [1]. Its three main lines are Gokujyun for intense hydration, Shirojyun, which adds brightening, and Gokujyun Alpha, which adds anti-aging ingredients [1]. A separate US-market line, Hada Labo Tokyo, is made by Rohto subsidiary Mentholatum with different branding and formulation [1].

paras: Hada Labo products center on hyaluronic acid. The company describes a blend of three hyaluronic acid forms of differing molecular size, intended to hydrate the surface and deeper skin layers [2]. Hyaluronic acid is a common cosmetic ingredient listed with skin-conditioning and humectant functions [3]. Its flagship lotion is reported as Japan's top-selling lotion for many consecutive years, though the exact figure varies by source [1][2].

Rohto was founded in Osaka in 1899 by Yasutami Yamada as a pharmacy, and acquired The Mentholatum Company in 1988 [4]. Hada Labo launched in 2004 [1]. In 2005 it moved from glass to plastic bottles and introduced refill pouches, and Hada Labo Tokyo entered US mass retail in 2015 [1]. In 2019 packaging for Gokujyun and Shirojyun moved to partly plant-derived materials [1].
The lotion is used after cleansing and before cream, a pattern popular in Japanese skincare. The brand also offers serums, creams, masks and cleansers [2].
No studies found. Hyaluronic acid injected as a dermal filler for wrinkles has FDA approval and lasts about 6 to 12 months, but that describes injections rather than topical lotions [3].
